title: SAS Administrator
description:
:
**About the role:**

  

The role is based in the Pune R\&D Centre, at SAS R\&D Pune facility. For this role, you will join the SAS9 team. We are looking for a SAS Administrator to help deployment validation for complex deployment scenarios for SAS 9\.4 and Viya 3\.5 platforms and automate deployment validation tasks.


In this role, you will work on deployment validation, system setup, and platform\-level customization. You will collaborate with a team of experienced engineers to automate the validation activities.

 **Primary Responsibilities**

* Your primary responsibility will include deployment validation for SAS 9\.4 and Viya 3\.5 products and solutions. Including but not limited to complex scenarios like horizontal and vertical clustering, multi\-tier, FIPS / TLS, MFA etc.
* Design and implement configuration logic using scripting and automation techniques.
* Configure automation pipeline and scripts for using DevOps tools like Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab.
* Work with Application teams to architect and design complex deployment scenarios.
* Develop and manage configuration templates, system properties, and environment\-specific settings.
* Implement secure configuration practices including handling TLS/SSL settings and certificate integration.
* Collaborate with developers and platform engineers to support application configuration requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to configuration scripts and system setup.
* Contribute to improvements in configuration frameworks, tools, and scripting standards.
* Participate in design discussions and contribute to new tooling, systems, and frameworks.
* Ensure adherence to security standards and deployment best practices.
* Contribute to unit testing, integration testing, and documentation of configuration\-related changes.
* Support junior team members and assist in knowledge sharing.

 **Requirement**

* 5 to 15 years of experience in SAS Administration, including hands\-on experience on installing and configuring SAS products and solutions.
* Strong understanding of SAS 9\.4 and Viya 3\.5 platforms and operating systems like Linux, Unix, Windows and z/OS.
* Experience with DevOps tools like Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab.
* Good scripting experience in Unix/Linux shell scripting and/or Windows Batch scripting.
* Installing, configuring and administrating SAS software and solutions
* Good to have SAS Platform Administrator Certification
* Programming in Base SAS
* Working knowledge of Apache Tomcat.
* Deploying and managing JavaEE web application.
* Understanding of XML and configuration\-driven systems.
* Strong understanding of TLS/SSL concepts and certificate handling.
* Working knowledge of Java (ability to read/debug code).
* Experience with version control tools such as Git or Gerrit.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Familiar with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Understanding of CI/CD concepts and pipelines.
* Basic understanding of multi\-tier application architecture and deployments.
* Quick learner with the ability to understand new tools and technologies.
* Understanding of software development processes and quality practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

 **Mandatory Technical skills**

* Good exposure to SAS Administration, including hands\-on experience on installing and configuring SAS products and solutions.
* Strong understanding of SAS 9\.4 and Viya 3\.5 platforms and operating systems like Linux, Unix, Windows and z/OS.
* Experience with DevOps tools like Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab.
* Good scripting experience in Unix/Linux shell scripting and/or Windows Batch scripting.
* Installing, using and administrating SAS software and solutions
* Good scripting knowledge in Unix/Linux shell scripting and/or Windows Batch scripting.
* Understanding of XML and configuration\-driven systems.
* Strong understanding of TLS/SSL concepts and certificate handling.
* Working knowledge of JAVA programming, OOPS concepts, SOLID principles.
* Understanding and exposure to DevOps tools (Python, Ansible etc.)

title: AS/400 Administrator
description:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full\-time
### **Job Details**


**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

  

* Required Skills Perform IBM i (**AS400/iSeries**) administration, including system installation, IBM Program Temporary Fixes (PTFs), software installation, configuration, HMC/LPAR administration, security administration, and operating system maintenance.
* Perform daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of IBM i hardware, server resources, system performance, scheduled jobs, backups, and critical system processes.
* Recommend, schedule, and implement IBM i hardware/software upgrades, PTFs, operating system upgrades, maintenance activities, and infrastructure improvements.
* Perform problem isolation, root cause analysis, incident resolution, and follow\-up for IBM i software, hardware, application, and user\-reported issues in a production environment.
* Review system and application logs, verify scheduled jobs, backup completion, and maintain High Availability (**MIMIX/PowerHA**) and Disaster Recovery environments.
* Install, upgrade, configure, test, and maintain IBM i and third\-party software applications.
* Control user access, manage user profiles, authorities, passwords, and maintain a secure IBM i environment including **SOX** compliance activities.
* Administer and maintain the **Automic** scheduling environment and support enterprise batch operations.
* Provide L2 operational support across **Windows/Linux servers**, Microsoft **Azure** (preferred) or AWS cloud environments, **VMware**, enterprise **storage**, and **backup** platforms (Veeam/ExaGrid or equivalent).
* Participate in infrastructure automation initiatives using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar scripting technologies.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Network, Security, Storage, and Application teams on production support, planned maintenance, infrastructure projects, and operational improvements.
* Participate in on\-call support for emergency Change Requests (CRs), Priority\-1 (P1\) incidents, planned maintenance, and Disaster Recovery activities.
* Prepare operational documentation, support internal/external audits, and continuously identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency
  

  

**Required Skills**

  

  

* Proven hands\-on experience in IBM i (AS400/iSeries) Administration within enterprise production environments.
* Proven experience with IBM Program Temporary Fixes (PTFs), HMC, LPAR Administration, BRMS, IBM i Security Administration, User Profile Management, High Availability/Disaster Recovery (MIMIX/PowerHA or equivalent), Automic, CL (Control Language), Query/400, SQL Principles, DB2, FTP/SFTP, TCP/IP, IBM MQ, Client Access (iSeries Access), and SOX Compliance.
* Proven hands\-on experience supporting Windows Server and/or Linux Administration in production environments.
* Demonstrated operational experience supporting Microsoft Azure (preferred) or AWS Cloud Administration, including infrastructure monitoring, user administration, operational support, and incident resolution.
* Proven experience with VMware Administration, Enterprise Storage Administration, and Enterprise Backup platforms (Veeam, ExaGrid, or equivalent).
* Experience working within ITIL\-based production support environments covering Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and customer\-facing skills with the ability to independently handle production incidents and infrastructure issues.
* Experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar scripting technologies for automation and operational efficiency.
  

  

  

**Preferred Skills**

  

  

* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise infrastructure across multiple technology domains in addition to IBM i.
* Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Dell PowerEdge Platforms, SAN/NAS Storage.
* VMware vSphere Administration.
* Azure and/or AWS infrastructure administration.
* Infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, Nagios, PRTG, or equivalent.
* JDE World, JDE OneWorld, Hawkeye, DBU, Crystal Reports.
  

  

**Experience**

  

  

  

* **4\+ years of proven hands\-on experience supporting IBM i (AS400/iSeries) operating systems in enterprise production environments.**
* 2\+ years of demonstrated production support experience in one or more of the following areas: Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, Windows Server, Linux, VMware, Enterprise Storage, or Backup technologies.
* Candidates should be able to demonstrate real\-world implementation, administration, troubleshooting, and production support experience across the technologies listed above during technical interviews.
